m: The *twins* pile up *soil* step by step until they can sit high on the **throne steps**.
Behind the *hillside*, only the pale *moon* reaches: a cool patch of **shade** all day long.
A *standing person* swings a *halberd* at the trunk until it crashes down: the **lumberjack** at work.
Tie a *bundle* of reeds, cut a mouthpiece with a *standing knife*, and blow: a loud **trumpet**.
The *watcher* sleeps until the **alarm clock** rings and his eyes pop open.
Hook the tip of an *ox horn* into the rope and twist: an **untied knot** falls loose.
Lying on the *sickbed*, hit by an *arrow* of heat: a burning **fever**.
*Crumbs* of sound shake loose from the tower as the **joy bells** ring out for the wedding.
The *dog* sticks its *nose* in the bin and backs away: what a **stink**.
Pull the *cloth cover* off the desk, lay out a *gift* of paper: a proper **writing desk**.
Pull the *cloth roll* out of the pipe and the *tumbling baby*'s bathwater gushes: an **unclogged drain**.
A lone *mountain* sticks up out of the sea, with birds circling its top: an **island**.
Under a *roof*, with a single *grass blade* growing by the door: a simple **dwelling**.
A *claw* lifts the three-legged bronze cup for the king: a fancy **wine goblet**.
Bury burnt wood in the *mountain* and it turns not to *ash* but to black **charcoal**.
The *husband* draws a perfect circle while the *watcher* checks it: a drawing **compass**.
*Rice* fields at night, and *dancing feet* of blue light flicker over them: a **will-o'-the-wisp**.
*Chatter* stops when a *leaky pot* crashes to the floor behind you: a **jump scare**.
Climb on the *roof* and shout to the *horizon* through a big cone: the **megaphone**.
A *woman* rocks a little bundle wrapped in shells and beads: her **baby**.
In the *town square*, an old man feeds birds and fluffs their *feathers*: kind **grandpa**.
At the *gate*, lean on the wooden bars along the balcony: the **railing**.
A gentle *claw* of a hand pats the crying *woman* on the head: a **soothing hand**.
An *old man* who has watched the *sun* rise for a hundred years: your **great-grandpa**.
The *watcher* points a camera at every temple on the tour: a busy **sightseer**.
A *helping hand* comes down on another and a *white dove* flies off at the **clap**.
Tie a *bundle* of reeds into a tube and suck through it with a *yawn*: a **sipping straw**.
Bend a *spear* made from a *tree* branch and it bounces back: a **springy twig**.
Put a second *shell* next to the first: a **second coin** in your pocket.
Wrap the *covered pig* in *grass* so it can't see where it's going: a **blindfold**.
The *busy man* rushes past every *hillside* to reach the big **capital city**.
Two *buddies* yodel on the *mountain* and the snow comes roaring down: an **avalanche**.
A swirling *tattoo* is etched all along a *standing knife*: the warrior's **tattooed blade**.
Behind the *grove* stands an *altar* nobody may touch: the **forbidden grove**.
A *person* chases the *goblin* out of the hen house, feathers flying: the **fowl** are safe.
Wearing a *summer hat*, a knight drops his *halberd* on the stones: **clank**.
Built high on raised *soil*, with tall pillars and a wide floor: the **main hall**.
Peer through a *magnifying glass* at the *page* held upside down: you are doing a **headstand**.
All the family gather together under one *square* banner: the whole **clan** is here.
Past the last *village*, an *offering* left for the wild animals: the **wilderness**.
A *flapping flag* waves and your *heart* jumps: **hurry**, the race has begun.
Around the *feast* on the *hillside* the people build a thick **city wall**.
The *scholar* fills one big jar with ink: a single **one jug**, nothing more.
Your *heart* jumps out of the *queue* and runs wild: a **runaway heart**.
In the *shed* the *servant* beats the grain, and the **rice husk** flies off.
Bitter grey *grass* hanging by the door to keep the bugs away: **wormwood**.
*Twin blades* cut every price, and each *shell* buys twice as much: the **bargain bin**.
A *tiger* prowls over a broken *scaffold* in the old city: nothing but **ruins**.
A *bent knife* of roof juts out over the door, keeping off the rain: the **eaves**.
The *little fortune stick* stirs the stew while the *lying man* naps: a big **black pot**.
Close your *eye* to a *pinch* and squint: you see with just **one eye**.
At the *gate*, a man with a *tattoo* bows his head in sorrow: the **mourner**.
Under the *roof*, the judge holds the truth up on a *skewer*: the **courtroom**.
The *elbow* bends to set a crown of *grass* on his head: the **officer's cap**.
Before you *exit* the room, put a lid on the *dish*: a **lidded dish**.
A *grain stalk* with no grain, shiny as a *small table*: a **bald head**.
A *yoke* lifted from the people's shoulders, *grass* strewn at his feet: the town's **hero**.
